name: Campingbuffet Hiasenhof
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Campingbuffet Hiasenhof in Tirol! Discover the perfect blend of nature and comfort in the heart of the Alps.
beschreibung: The Campingbuffet Hiasenhof in Kufstein treats its guests to an exquisite selection of regional and seasonal dishes. The cuisine combines traditional Tyrolean recipes with creative accents, creating a unique culinary experience. The cozy interior invites you to linger, while attentive service ensures the well-being of every guest. Particularly recommended is the homemade Tyrolean dumpling soup (Tiroler Knödelsuppe), which is wonderfully warming after a long day of hiking. In addition, the restaurant offers a carefully curated wine list featuring fine wines from South Tyrol and Austria.
